The escalators are out of order between the low level booking office and the high level at Glasgow Central station.

If you need to re-arrange your travel plans because of this, please get in touch with ScotRail's free Assisted Travel Helpline 0800 046 1634 or Assisted Travel Textphone 18001 0800 046 1634 (for people who are hard of hearing).
